label: Vignette Removal
blurb: Brightens the dark corners a wide lens, a cheap adapter or a lens hood leaves, in linear light the way the light was lost, so the sky and walls come out even. Amount is how many stops darker the corners are; Midpoint sets how far in the darkening starts; Roundness follows the frame's shape or a circle; highlights that would blow out are rolled off softly instead. Show the correction draws the brightening as grey to line it up on a flat wall.
